input.answer: I'd pick the first one, "א. מגדלי מטבעות": the sentence above it, "כל שקל שהפקדתם נהיה 3.70 ₪ בקרן ו-1.09 ₪ בחשבון ניירות ערך", and the plain table under it showed me that the employer's money makes the keren much better. The other two, with the falling block and the coloured stacks, I didn't really understand.

stuck.where: Top of screen 1, the orange-and-grey paragraph under the three boxes
stuck.why: It's full of S&P500, 'מיטב השתלמות עוקב מדד', 'דמי ניהול 0.54%', 'מסלול' and an orange ⚠. I didn't know if that was a warning to me, so I left it.
I couldn't tell the yellow, green and striped pink dots apart well enough to count them. It said one coin is 1,000 ₪, but I didn't count. I used the sentence and the table instead.

stuck.where: Option B, the waterfall with 0 to 200,000
stuck.why: The boxes float in the air, and there's a minus, '−13,974 ₪', with a red-striped block. That frightened me and I didn't understand which block was mine.

stuck.where: The little year bars with 'לפני 6 שנים: מס'
stuck.why: I didn't know whether I was supposed to press them. The text said you can drag ('לגרור'), and I don't drag.

used: Box 'הכסף של המעסיק +900 ₪ בחודש': for every shekel of mine, 3 more come from the employer
Sentence 'כל שקל שהפקדתם נהיה 3.70 ₪ בקרן ו-1.09 ₪ בחשבון ניירות ערך'
The table: 'ההפקדות שלכם' 18,000 both sides, 'הפקדות המעסיק' 54,000 against 'אין'
skimmed: The three boxes at the top (I only took the first big number, +1,721 and +900)
The descriptions under the headings for options B and C
Option C's stacked bars, where I only saw that they climb and the bottom line with 66,513 / 18,000 / 19,595
skipped: The small orange-grey paragraph with S&P500, fund numbers and management fees
The small grey lines under the table ('בקרן, בין 19 המסלולים... 0.7%... 0.19%')
The numbers on the waterfall's axis
unsure_meaning: 'דמי ניהול 0.54%' and how it eats the money
The 'מומלץ' tag: who is recommending, and why
The white line in option C

findings.what: The whole page is black with pale grey writing. Even enlarged, with my glasses on, the small lines were hard to read
findings.where: All screens, especially the footnotes and the axis numbers

findings.what: Right at the top there's a paragraph with English letters and fund names. If I'd come to this by myself I'd have thought it wasn't for me
A minus in red and a red-striped block ('−13,974 ₪', 'מס במשיכה') make me back away, even though I understood the keren still comes out ahead
findings.where: Option A's table and option B

findings.what: The dots in yellow, green and striped pink are too close in colour and too many to count
The waterfall chart isn't a normal chart; I didn't understand why the blocks float

It says to drag the years. I don't use that, and it wasn't clear whether I was supposed to press
findings.where: The year bars above each option

findings.what: Nowhere does it say whether the money is safe or can fall, and that's the first thing I wanted to know
